East low service wing has three separate outward pitches, two grade-level doors and local lower vents/upper short windows; central gray roof and high interior-facing window strips remain. It is not an open-to-ground court. East main hall joins wing through narrow lower connector; no neighboring PV building.

Complete west front fits frame; single tall hall above partial exposed basement, not two above-ground equal stories; broad center stair, open recessed porch and cream frame; shop signs omitted rather than invented.

Square four hip roof with centered square low cap, connected smaller east three-pitch roof complex and gray central covered zone. West stair centered, north stair near center, south stair shifted west; no mirror error. Unknown later service-yard objects excluded, not asserted absent in real site.

Opposite side confirms northcentral stair, non-full-length basement opening strip, chamfered hall walls under square roof, solid service-slope ends instead of accidental triangular air slits; whole model in frame.
